title: Servers without open incidents
description: Return production servers for which there are no incidents with resolved = 0. Servers with resolved incidents only must remain. Return exactly one column: hostname. Sort by hostname ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT s.hostname
FROM servers AS s
hints: Place resolved = 0 in ON so a resolved incident does not remove the server.
After the LEFT JOIN, absence of an open match is detected by a NULL incident id.
solution_explanation: Filtering the right table inside ON creates an anti-join specifically against open incidents.
